steps.title: Namespace
steps.body: Native and custom connectors occupy separate namespaces.

steps.title: Parallel
steps.body: Run both connectors in parallel during the transition.

steps.title: Artifacts
steps.body: Agents, saved searches, app filters, and pinned results scoped to the native connector will not recognize the custom connector's content. Migrate them.

steps.title: Deactivate last
steps.body: Deactivating a native connector removes its content from the search index.
